question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. A sits fifth from the right end. Only two people sit between E and A. C is an immediate neighbour of G and E. B sits to the immediate right of F. How many people sit between D and B?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

A sits fifth from the right end.

Only two people sit between E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4aff818955da5c4b2351ecfd897437e7566d7752e9d310c14d4a3250e46144b.png] 

C is an immediate neighbour of G and E.</
